list.title: Pipelines
list.subtitle: Scans built from worker blocks, run on demand or on a schedule.
list.empty: No pipelines yet. Build one from worker blocks.
list.runActive: A run of this pipeline is still going

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The pipeline and its schedule are deleted. Scans it already ran, and their results, stay.

editor.subtitle: Pick targets, chain worker blocks and set a schedule.
editor.readOnly: Your role can view this pipeline but not change it.
editor.unsaved: Save your changes before running the pipeline.
editor.invalid: Some fields are invalid. Fix the ones marked in red.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: The changes to this pipeline are not saved yet and will be lost.

targets.title: Targets
targets.hint: What this step scans on every run, taken from the target inventory. Addresses outside the inventory are never scanned.
targets.selectHint: Tick a tag to take every target that carries it, or tick single targets. Nothing ticked: every target in the inventory.

picker.nothingSelected: Nothing selected: every target in the inventory.
picker.noPermission: Listing the inventory needs the targets:read permission. The selection above stays as it is.
picker.emptyInventory: The target inventory is empty, so this step would have nothing to scan.
picker.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} targets. Search to find the others.

coverage.domains_one: {{count}} domain, resolved when a run starts
coverage.domains_other: {{count}} domains, resolved when a run starts

picker.missingTags: No target has these tags: {{tags}}. Tags are case-sensitive.
picker.missingTargets_one: {{count}} picked target is no longer in the inventory.
picker.missingTargets_other: {{count}} picked targets are no longer in the inventory.
picker.nothingMatches: No target matches this selection, so this step would have nothing to scan.
picker.outsideRanges: None of the selected targets lies within the addresses below, so this step would have nothing to scan.

targets.rangesHint: IPv4 addresses and CIDRs. Empty: the whole of the selected targets.

steps.title: Steps
steps.hint: Blocks run in order. A later block can take the hosts and open ports the block before it found, so Nmap only probes what Masscan saw open.
steps.noWorkers: No worker is registered yet. Workers appear once a worker manager asks for work.
steps.empty: Add the first block from the list above.

inputs.previous: Hosts and open ports from step {{index}}

flow.previous: passes on the hosts and open ports it found
flow.targets: the next block scans its own targets

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hint: Run times and how long each run may scan. Jobs left when the time window closes wait for the next run time and continue then.
schedule.activeHint: Off keeps the schedule but stops it from firing.
schedule.window: Limit each run to a time window
schedule.windowHint: Must not be longer than the interval.
schedule.noRuns: This schedule never runs: no run time falls on the selected days.

paramIssues.unknown: Not a setting of this worker
paramIssues.path: Each path must start with a single /

params.probe_paths: HTTP paths to probe, one per line

startDialog.title: Start a scan
startDialog.description: Run a pipeline now over its targets. To scan new addresses, import them first.

workers.title: Workers
workers.subtitle: Building blocks for pipelines. They appear on their own when a manager asks for work.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Only the registry entry is deleted. If a manager still offers this worker, it is registered again.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.maxRateHint: No step of this worker may send more.

managers.title: Worker managers
managers.subtitle: Managers that asked for work. Online means active in the last 2 minutes.
managers.empty: No manager has asked for work yet. Start one with pnpm workers:manager:poll.
